field_principles.action_byte_identity_results: Byte identity proves the shadow did not mutate actions.
field_principles.atom_mapping_manifest: The manifest shows generic live atoms mapped to the shared program.
field_principles.canonical_reachability_receipt: Reachability proves the hook sits on the live ARC path.
field_principles.default_off_receipt: The receipt proves the submitted default does not arm the monitor.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time exposes skipped or fabricated reducer execution.
field_principles.exact_agreement_results: Agreement counts compare the guard with external receipt facts.
field_principles.experiment_id: The identifier binds this artifact to REQ-ARC-6846.
field_principles.false_intervention_results: False intervention rows show safe facts blocked by the guard.
field_principles.field_principles: Each top-level field states why an auditor needs it.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked verdict names the first failed check and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The complete_ prefix states the terminal evidence boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: This is deterministic CPU canonical-path shadow replay.
field_principles.latency_results: Latency rows prove the shadow replay stayed within its bound.
field_principles.missed_violation_results: Missed violation rows show unsafe facts admitted by the guard.
field_principles.per_game_results: One row per frozen terminal receipt keeps guard, truth, and latency local.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: The gates show which frozen evidence was required.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: One digest binds the replay content except wall time.
field_principles.run_date: The date states when the frozen shadow replay was built.
field_principles.schema: The schema lets later reducers reject incompatible Exp6846 files.
field_principles.solve_claim: False prevents a shadow monitor receipt from becoming a solve claim.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Source hashes bind the frozen artifacts and live seam files.
field_principles.status: The status separates ready replay artifacts from blocked gate artifacts.
field_principles.typed_arc_shadow_monitor_ready_score: The score is 1 only when all readiness gates pass.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed verdict class prevents unsupported positives.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because external trajectory facts define truth.
